title: Nasty Juice Trap Queen 50/50 10ml E-Liquid
description: Luscious summer strawberries meets authentic garden mint in this extraordinary e-liquid from Nasty Juice. The plump, soft, scarlet strawberries unfold on the inhale followed by the cool floral freshness of mint. This e-liquid from Nasty Juice offers a perfect balance of PG and VG, providing immaculate flavour and rich, satisfying clouds. This e-liquid is versatile enough to be used with most vape devices but are ideal for low-powered starter kits , pen-vape kits and pod kits .
